description: This file implements the CrossToolProtocol class which handles message-based communication between tools, including bug report and timestamp messages, with origin validation and event handling.

classes.name: RemoteTool
classes.description: Helper class representing a remote tool with a window and origin.

classes.name: CrossToolProtocol
classes.description: Main class implementing message handling for remote bug reports and timestamps, supporting multiple interfaces.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CrossToolProtocol instance and sets up message event listener.

methods.name: setOnBugreportReceived
methods.description: Sets callback for bug report reception.

methods.name: sendTimestamp
methods.description: Sends a timestamp message to the remote tool if available.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events, validates origin, and processes message types.

methods.name: onMessageBugreportReceived
methods.description: Processes bug report messages and invokes callback.

methods.name: onMessageTimestampReceived
methods.description: Processes timestamp messages and invokes callback.
